text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc chief financial officer Don Peterson said on Monday that Lucent's second quarter ending this month is expected to be "substantially up" from the same three months in 1996.
Peterson made no forecast in an investors meeting sponsored by Raymond James & Associates Inc but said, "It will be up substantially from last year, I think."

Wall Street analysts, according to a survey by First Call, forecast that the maker of telephone equipment would earn between $0.01 and $0.08 a share in its fiscal second quarter, versus a $0.16 a share loss in the year-ago period. First Call's mean estimate is a profit of $0.04 a share.
Peterson said the March quarter was traditionally Lucent's weakest, a trend unlikely to change.
Analysts expect Lucent, spun off by AT&T Corp in late 1995, to earn $2.08 in fiscal 1997 and $2.48 a share in fiscal 1998, according to First Call. The company earned $1.65 a share in fiscal 1996.
